model.name: 10Eros-Max H3 FL2VA 8-Step Turbo beta7 fix1 20B
model.description: TenStrip/10Eros-Max beta7 fix1 (https://huggingface.co/TenStrip/10Eros-Max): a merge built on MiniMax H3, pruned 20B, with an 8-step turbo baked in. First/last frame to video and audio. Installed by Glass Studio (hologram/studio/finetunes).
model.infos:
### 10Eros-Max beta7 fix1 (FL2VA)

One BF16 checkpoint (40 GB) for both FL2VA and Ref2VA, a PDD model like H3's own PDD 8-step: its final layer holds 32 heads, head 0 whole and heads 1-31 as differences from head 0, which Glass Studio's pdd_heads.py unpacks into WanGP's heads module (10Eros_Max_h3_8stepTURBO_beta7_fix1_pdd_heads_fp32.safetensors, made from the checkpoint the first time). It uses H3's own text encoder (Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct layer 50), video VAE and audio VAE, which WanGP brings with the architecture. Its fused QKV rows are **grouped** (Q, then K, then V), unlike the official interleaved H3 files: checked row by row against WanGP's pruned H3 (Nov 15, 2026). 8 steps on the 32-interval PDD grid, Euler, flow shift 12 (audio 3), guidance 1. No VSA gates in this file: dense attention.
